analysis.one_line_summary: A young woman provides a clear step-by-step tutorial on how to use the Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush for salon-quality curls and root volume at home in 15 minutes.
analysis.full_description: The video starts with a young female creator showcasing bouncy blowout curls, explaining that she will demonstrate a slowed-down tutorial on how to use the Wavytalk Blowout Boost thermal brush. She shows her heat protectant, notes her heat setting (360°F), and demonstrates how to tension-pull the hair and twist at the end for a curl. She then teaches a second technique to create spiral curls by rolling vertically and unraveling without tangling. She shows how brushing underneath the crown section adds instant root lift, promising that once mastered, a full blowout takes only around 15 minutes. The video finishes with her flaunting her voluminous, shiny blowout and holding up the tool.

analysis.transcript_full_original: This is how my hair looks when I normally do blowouts. So I'm gonna be doing a slowed-down version on how to use this Blowout Boost. We're gonna go in with our heat protectant. Now the temperature will completely depend on your hair type. I personally put mine at 360. Once again, you are going to wrap the hair around and then making sure that you can see the bristles through the hair, you are going to pull down with a good amount of tension. And then you can just give it a little twist at the end to form your little curl. And simply roll it off. And to create more of a spiral, you are going to once again horizontally pull the brush down, making sure you see the bristles over the hair. And then, once you roll it, you are going to slowly roll it up and turn it vertically. Once it's vertical like this, you just slowly unravel and slightly pull, your hair will not tangle if you follow the steps properly. And then you get the full curl. And for the right side of your face, you are also twisting it outwards onto the handle. You can go ahead and start a little bit away from the root. And as you can see, because we went underneath the section first, we have now that added volume at the roots. I promise that once you do get the hang of it, you will easily be able to do your blowouts in 15 minutes or so.

I promise that once you do get the hang of it, you will easily be able to do your blowouts in 15 minutes or so.
